journey.name: Blocking an account — gone from everywhere, unblocked only from Settings (#577)
journey.description:
A block is pubky.app's mute record (/pub/pubky.app/mutes/{pubky}), so it is shared with pubky.app both ways. A blocked account is not shown anywhere: its decks and profile leave Discover, tag browse, search, follow lists, Home, Library and the study queue, a link to its profile or one of its decks shows only "You blocked this account", and the only Unblock is Settings → Blocked accounts. Blocking in Loopky also unfollows the account and its decks; a mute made on pubky.app hides them without unfollowing anything.
Needs a signed-in session (journey 01 or 20) and a second staging account B that has published at least one deck and self-tagged as a Loopky user. Follow B and one of B's decks first, and keep a share link to B's profile and to that deck. Use staging accounts only. Run on Android and on iOS — the accessibility identifiers are the same on both.

actions.action: Open Discover and note B's deck tile in browse and B in the people strip. Tap B's name to open "friend_profile_screen"

Verify the nav row shows "friend_profile_share" and, beside it, "friend_profile_more". Open it and verify two items, "friend_profile_report" ("Report", journey 32) and "friend_profile_block" ("Block"), both in the danger colour — and no Unblock anywhere on the screen

Tap "friend_profile_block" and verify an alert titled "Block {B's name}?" saying their decks and profile will be hidden, that you will stop following them and their decks, that they are not told, and that this also mutes them on pubky.app. Tap "block_cancel" and verify nothing changed — Follow still reads "Following"
Open the menu again, tap "friend_profile_block", then "block_confirm". Verify the profile CLOSES back to Discover (Android also shows a "Blocked" toast)
Verify on the homeserver that /pub/pubky.app/mutes/{B} exists with a microsecond created_at, and that /pub/pubky.app/follows/{B} and the subscription record for B's deck are gone
Verify Discover no longer shows B's tile or B's person card, without pulling to refresh. Pull to refresh and verify they stay gone
Verify B's deck is on neither Home nor Library, and that "Study" does not serve its cards

Open a tag chip that B's deck carries (journey 13) and verify B's deck is not in the grid. Search B's name and B's deck title and verify neither comes back. Open the follow list of someone who follows B and verify B is not in it

LINKS. Open the share link to B's profile and verify "friend_profile_blocked" reading "You blocked this account" — no name, no avatar, no decks, no share, no menu, no Unblock. Open the link to B's deck and verify "deck_detail_blocked" with only a back button

Open Settings and verify, in the Sharing section under "Share on Pubky", a row "settings_blocked_users" reading "Blocked accounts". Tap it and verify B is listed as "blocked_row_0" with "blocked_unblock_0", and that tapping the row itself opens nothing
Tap "blocked_unblock_0" and verify the row leaves the list and "blocked_users_empty" reads "You haven't blocked any accounts."
Pull to refresh Discover and verify B's deck and person card are back, and B's profile link opens the full profile. Verify B and B's deck are NOT followed again — unblocking restores nothing

PUBKY.APP. Follow B's deck again, then mute B on pubky.app (staging) and relaunch Loopky. Verify B's deck is gone from Home and Library but the subscription record is still on the homeserver, B is listed under "Blocked accounts", and B's profile link opens blocked. Unblock there and verify B is unmuted on pubky.app and the deck is back on Home
GUEST. Signed out, open any profile and verify "friend_profile_more" holds "friend_profile_report" and no "friend_profile_block", and Settings has no "settings_blocked_users"
SELF. Open your own profile through a link and verify there is no "friend_profile_more"
OFFLINE. With the network cut, try to block and verify "friend_profile_error" says why and the profile stays open and unblocked
TABLET / IPAD. At expanded width verify the blocked notice and the Blocked accounts list are pane-capped, not edge to edge
DARK. With the dark theme verify the menu, the alert, the blocked notice and Block in the danger colour are legible
